items.title: De novo Rubisco design with protein language models
items.abstract_or_text: Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase (Rubisco) fixes the majority of carbon dioxide globally but is challenged with low specificity for CO2 versus O2 and low catalytic efficiencies. Traditional engineering efforts have remained difficult because folding, assembly, specificity, and catalysis are tightly coupled, hampering efforts to explore sequence space. Therefore, we leveraged recent advances in protein large language models (PLMs) to generate sequences beyond those observed in nature, using both ProGen-2 that was fine-tuned on a limited dataset of non-Form I Rubiscos and an ESM-2 discriminator. With this approach, we generated 5.6 million novel Rubisco-like sequences and identified 21 highly diverse candidates predicted to be active that occupy regions of Rubisco phylogenetic space not previously observed in nature. Six designs were soluble in Escherichia coli, and five were shown to produce quantifiable 3PGA. One design produced an apparent CO2/O2 specificity estimate beyond the range of the natural representative Rubiscos assayed. We also solved the crystal structure of one de novo design that reproduced the predicted dimer and active-site geometry with sub-angstrom C agreement. Sequence-only generation followed by independent structural filtering therefore recovered soluble, active Rubiscos from regions of sequence space that are not represented in genomic databases. Together, these results establish a scalable strategy for accessing previously unexplored Rubisco sequence space, providing a broadly accessible path toward generating de novo Rubiscos that may have activity and specificity parameters needed to address longstanding limitations in biological carbon fixation.
items.summary_zh: 以 ProGen-2 生成并由 ESM-2 筛选新型 Rubisco 序列；21个候选中6个可溶、5个产生可定量检测的 3PGA，且一个设计的晶体结构验证了预测二聚体与活性位点几何。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将序列生成、独立结构筛选与功能及结构实验串联，为拓展天然序列空间中的碳固定酶提供了有说服力的路径；活性与 CO2/O2 特异性仍需在更广泛条件和更多设计中验证。
items.abstract_zh: Ribulose-1,5-bisphosphate carboxylase/oxygenase（Rubisco）固定了全球大部分二氧化碳，但其对 CO2 相对于 O2 的特异性低，且催化效率低。传统工程改造工作仍然困难，因为折叠、组装、特异性和催化紧密耦合，阻碍了对序列空间的探索。因此，我们利用蛋白质大语言模型（PLMs）的最新进展，使用在有限的非 Form I Rubisco 数据集上微调的 ProGen-2 以及 ESM-2 判别器，生成了超出自然界已观察到范围的序列。借助该方法，我们生成了560万个新型 Rubisco 样序列，并鉴定出21个预测具有活性的、高度多样化的候选物；它们位于此前在自然界未观察到的 Rubisco 系统发育空间区域。六个设计在 Escherichia coli 中可溶，五个被证明能产生可定量检测的 3PGA。一个设计产生了表观 CO2/O2 特异性估计值，超出所测定的天然代表性 Rubisco 的范围。我们还解析了一个从头设计的晶体结构，其重现了预测的二聚体和活性位点几何，具有亚埃级 C 一致性。因而，纯序列生成加上独立的结构筛选，能够从基因组数据库未覆盖的序列空间区域中获得可溶且有活性的 Rubisco。总之，这些结果建立了一种可扩展策略，用于进入此前未探索的 Rubisco 序列空间，为生成可能具有解决生物碳固定长期局限所需活性和特异性参数的从头 Rubisco 提供了一条广泛可及的路径。
items.author_line: Kehl, A. J., Chu, S. K. S., Pereira, J. H., Lee, J., Wang, R. Z., Gigl, M., Adams, P. D., Shih, P. M., Siegel, J. B.

items.title: Toward De Novo Protein Design from Natural Language
items.abstract_or_text: Programming biological function-designing bespoke proteins to perform specified molecular tasks-is a foundational goal of molecular engineering. However, current design paradigms remain fundamentally limited: they typically require either natural proteins as starting points for optimization or manual reformulation of functional goals as geometric and sequence-level constraints to guide candidate generation. Here we introduce Pinal, a 16-billion-parameter foundation model that designs candidate proteins from natural-language descriptions of desired function. Trained on 1.7 billion synthetically annotated protein-text pairs, Pinal links functional intent to protein sequence and structure. In computational evaluations, generated candidates combined high predicted foldability with functional-description alignment and sequence diversity, providing a basis for prioritizing experimentally testable designs. We applied Pinal to four distinct design tasks-a fluorescent protein, a polyethylene terephthalate hydrolase, an alcohol dehydrogenase and a metabolic H-protein-and experimentally observed the intended function in each case, including catalytic activity for both designed enzymes. Crucially, without iterative experimental optimization, a Pinal-designed H-protein increased product titer by 1.7-fold relative to the corresponding native E. coli H-protein in a multi-enzyme CO2 fixation pathway. These findings support natural language as a high-level interface for candidate generation in protein design, enabling programmable exploration with reduced reliance on manually specified structural or sequence constraints.
items.summary_zh: 提出160亿参数的 Pinal，将自然语言功能描述映射为蛋白质序列和结构；在荧光蛋白、PET 水解酶、醇脱氢酶及代谢 H-protein 四项任务中均报告了目标功能实验结果。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 工作把高层功能意图直接作为蛋白设计接口，并给出多类功能的实验验证；训练数据为合成标注的 protein–text 对，功能描述对真实可设计性的泛化范围仍需审慎评估。
evidence_flags: 大规模合成标注训练数据
items.abstract_zh: 对生物功能进行编程——设计执行指定分子任务的定制蛋白质——是分子工程的一个基础目标。然而，当前设计范式仍受到根本性限制：它们通常需要以天然蛋白质为优化起点，或将功能目标手动重述为几何与序列层面的约束，以指导候选物生成。我们在此提出 Pinal，一个160亿参数的基础模型，可根据所需功能的自然语言描述设计候选蛋白质。Pinal 在17亿个合成标注的 protein–text 对上训练，将功能意图与蛋白质序列和结构关联起来。在计算评估中，生成的候选物同时具有较高的预测可折叠性、与功能描述的一致性以及序列多样性，为优先选择可进行实验检验的设计提供了基础。我们将 Pinal 应用于四项不同的设计任务——荧光蛋白、polyethylene terephthalate hydrolase、alcohol dehydrogenase 和 metabolic H-protein——并在每项任务中实验观察到预期功能，其中两种设计酶均具有催化活性。关键的是，在无需迭代实验优化的情况下，一个 Pinal 设计的 H-protein 在多酶 CO2 固定通路中使产物滴度相对于相应的天然 E. coli H-protein 提高了1.7倍。这些发现支持将自然语言作为蛋白设计中候选物生成的高层接口，从而以更少依赖人工指定的结构或序列约束的方式，实现可编程的探索。

items.title: A glass-box foundation model for density functional theory
items.abstract_or_text: Machine-learned exchange–correlation functionals promise accuracy beyond traditional forms, yet so far they trade interpretability for flexibility. Here we introduce DL-xDH26, a glass-box foundation model for density functional development on the fifth rung of Jacob’s ladder, with separate exchange and correlation expert towers, interpretable enhancement-factor and shift parameters relative to a physical base, and exact degree-one homogeneity. Trained exclusively on relative energies, it recovers atomic exchange and correlation energies and their quantum shell structure, and produces smooth, size-consistent dissociation curves without dispersion corrections, while reaching errors below 1 kcal/mol on the GMTKN55 and MGCDB84 benchmark suites. Lightweight fine-tuning then specializes the same backbone to cyclization reactions, distorted organic geometries, and organometallic reaction energetics while retaining its broad accuracy.
items.summary_zh: 提出可解释的第五阶 DFT 基础模型 DL-xDH26，以独立的交换与相关专家塔、相对物理基线可解释参数及精确一阶齐次性学习交换-相关泛函；在 GMTKN55 和 MGCDB84 上报告低于1 kcal/mol误差。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若结果可复现，该模型把机器学习泛函的精度与物理可解释性、尺寸一致性结合，可用于反应与有机金属能量计算；基准集表现和微调收益尚需独立评测。
items.abstract_zh: 机器学习的交换-相关泛函有望达到超越传统形式的精度，但迄今为止，它们以可解释性换取了灵活性。我们在此介绍 DL-xDH26：一个用于 Jacob’s ladder 第五阶密度泛函发展的玻璃盒基础模型，具有独立的交换和相关专家塔、相对于物理基线的可解释增强因子和位移参数，以及精确的一阶齐次性。该模型仅在相对能量上训练，却能恢复原子交换和相关能及其量子壳层结构；无需色散校正即可生成平滑、尺寸一致的解离曲线，同时在 GMTKN55 和 MGCDB84 基准套件上达到低于1 kcal/mol的误差。随后，轻量微调可将同一骨干网络专门用于环化反应、扭曲有机几何和有机金属反应能量，同时保留其广泛的准确性。
items.author_line: Sheng Bi, Shiqi Liu, Igor Ying Zhang, Xin Xu

items.title: Fast-Response Operando Mass Spectrometry Demystifies C₂ Product Formation in Cu-Catalyzed CO and CO₂ Reduction: Burst of Ethylene Isotopologues
items.abstract_or_text: It has been a long-standing challenge in electrocatalysis to measure product formation with kinetically relevant time resolution. Here, we couple a real-time gas analyzer mass spectrometer with a modified sampling inlet to a gas diffusion electrode cell, achieving sub-second time resolution for both reactant consumption and product formation. We focus on CO 2 /CO reduction on oxide-derived Cu, motivated by the continuing interest in its reaction mechanism and its high selectivity to ethylene (C 2 H 4 ) formation. Potential step experiments for CO reduction reveal that the initial consumption of CO is fast ( 2 H 4 products can be 10 times slower, which we attribute to the time required for CO storage on the Cu surface and subsequent reconstruction into the active, C 2+ -forming, configuration. Previous studies have reported that the co-feed of 12 CO 2 / 13 CO results in the enhancement of 13 C-containing ethylene isotopologues, but the mechanism causing this remains unknown. Isotopic-labeled gas switching ( 12 CO 2 - 13 CO) experiments yield compelling evidence that 13 C species continue to exist for more than a minute at near proximity to or on the catalyst, even after the supply source has been cut off, evidenced by the significant enhancement of 13 C-containing ethylene isotopologues: pure ( 13 C 2 H 4 ) and mixed ( 13 C 12 CH 4 ), formed through a CO 2 (g)-*CO pathway. Importantly, the size of the C 1 reservoir, the amount of 13 C 12 CH 4 made when CO 2 reacts with it, and the amount of Cu + that is removed are all in the micromole range. Thus, the picture emerges that a monolayer is stripped off from the copper catalyst surface during the CO-CO 2 switch. Tracking of dynamic Cu surface insights (i.e., activation, dissolution and deactivation) provides valuable mechanistic insights for optimizing reaction conditions.
items.summary_zh: 将快速响应在线质谱接入气体扩散电极电池，以亚秒时间分辨率追踪氧化物衍生 Cu 上 CO/CO2 还原；同位素切换结果指向近表面 13C 储库、表面重构及 C2 产物形成之间的动态耦合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 直接时间分辨的产物和反应物读出为 Cu 电催化 C2 选择性机理提供了较强实验约束，可指导动态工况优化；储库和表面剥离的机理解释仍应由正交表征进一步检验。
evidence_flags: 机制解释待进一步验证
items.abstract_zh: 在电催化中，以具有动力学相关性的时间分辨率测量产物形成一直是一项长期挑战。这里，我们将实时气体分析质谱仪与改进的取样入口耦合至气体扩散电极电池，实现了对反应物消耗和产物形成的亚秒时间分辨率。我们聚焦于氧化物衍生 Cu 上的 CO2/CO 还原，这是因为人们持续关注其反应机制及其对乙烯（C2H4）形成的高选择性。CO 还原的电势阶跃实验表明，初始 CO 消耗很快，而 C2H4 产物的形成可慢10倍；我们将其归因于 CO 在 Cu 表面储存以及随后重构为活性、形成 C2+ 的构型所需的时间。先前研究报道，12CO2/13CO 共进料会增强含13C 的乙烯同位素体，但导致这一现象的机制未知。同位素标记气体切换（12CO2–13CO）实验提供了有力证据：即使供应源已被切断，13C 物种仍在催化剂附近或表面存在超过一分钟；显著增强的含13C 乙烯同位素体——纯13C2H4和混合13C12CH4——即为证据，这些产物经由 CO2(g)-*CO 路径形成。重要的是，C1 储库的大小、CO2 与其反应时形成的13C12CH4 的量，以及被移除的 Cu+ 的量，都处于微摩尔范围。因此，出现了这样一幅图景：在 CO–CO2 切换期间，铜催化剂表面的一层单层被剥离。对动态 Cu 表面洞见（即活化、溶解和失活）的追踪，为优化反应条件提供了有价值的机制洞见。
items.author_line: Helen J. Zeng, Yesol Kim, Junko Yano, Joel W. Ager

items.title: Acoustic Emission to Provide Early Warning Detection of Lithium-Ion Battery Thermal Runaway
items.abstract_or_text: Understanding lithium-ion battery (LIB) degradation pathways and failure mechanisms is essential given the rare but potentially severe associated hazards. Recent regulations on thermal runaway prevention are driving the need for advanced early detection diagnostic techniques. Acoustic methods, including Acoustic Emission (AE) and Ultrasonic Testing (UT), are promising operando monitoring tools owing to their cost-effectiveness, non-invasive nature, and real-time capability to detect physical and electrochemical changes within cells. This study demonstrates the first use of AE as a diagnostic tool for monitoring stateof-health (SoH), state of safety, and early failure onset. AE measurements were correlated with high-speed synchrotron X-ray radiography, linking acoustic signals to real-time physical changes such as gas formation, cell-volume expansion, and cracking. Experiments across a range of SoC and SoH, covering pristine, aged, and cells cycled below 0 ºC, highlight the robustness of the approach. Machine learning algorithms trained across multiple chemistries and formats enabled real-time signal interpretation. AE reliably identified degradation mechanisms and issued failure alerts across a spectrum of severity, 2 including in lithium-plated cells, with synchrotron imaging confirming the physical origin of key signals. Integrating AE into battery management systems could significantly enhance LIB safety across automotive, grid storage, and manufacturing applications without compromising cost.
items.summary_zh: 以声发射结合高速同步辐射 X 射线成像监测锂离子电池热失控早期过程，并训练跨化学体系和电池形态的机器学习模型进行实时信号判读。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把低成本、非侵入式声学监测与物理成像验证结合，具有进入电池管理系统的应用潜力；不同使用场景下的误报率、泛化性及工程部署仍是关键限制。
items.abstract_zh: 鉴于相关危害虽罕见但可能严重，理解锂离子电池（LIB）劣化路径和失效机制至关重要。近期关于预防热失控的法规推动了对先进早期检测诊断技术的需求。声学方法，包括 Acoustic Emission（AE）和 Ultrasonic Testing（UT），因其成本效益、非侵入性以及实时检测电池内部物理和电化学变化的能力，而成为很有前景的 operando 监测工具。本研究展示了首次将 AE 用作监测健康状态（SoH）、安全状态和早期失效起始的诊断工具。AE 测量与高速同步辐射 X 射线照相相关联，将声学信号与气体形成、电池体积膨胀和开裂等实时物理变化联系起来。覆盖原始、老化和低于0 ºC循环的电池、并跨越一系列 SoC 和 SoH 的实验，突出了该方法的稳健性。针对多种化学体系和形态训练的机器学习算法实现了实时信号解释。AE 能可靠识别劣化机制，并针对不同严重程度发出失效警报，包括在锂析出的电池中；同步辐射成像确认了关键信号的物理起源。将 AE 整合到电池管理系统中，能够在不损害成本的情况下，显著提高汽车、电网储能和制造领域的 LIB 安全性。
items.author_line: Arthur Fordham, Inez Kesuma, Thomas Dore, Charlie Kirchner-Burles, Isabel Antony, Xiaoxia Guo, Julia Weaving, Mark Buckwell, Jian Peng, Pranay Gandharapu, Joshua Cruddos, Lara Rasha, Alexander Liptak, Stefan Michalik, Genoveva Burca, Wesley M Dose, Alexander J. items.title: A Zero-Shot Single-Point Chemical Language Model Mimics Medicinal Chemist Reasoning for Molecular Optimization and STING Inhibitor Development in Alzheimer’s Disease
items.abstract_or_text: Drug development relies heavily on the ability of medicinal chemists to identify productive, localized structural modifications that improve potency, selectivity, and developability while preserving favorable features of a lead scaffold. Here, we introduce the Single-Point Chemical Language Model (SpCLM), a zero-shot molecular optimization framework designed to computationally emulate this iterative medicinal chemistry paradigm. Built on a Transformer architecture, SpCLM performs controlled single-point molecular modifications encompassing common medicinal chemistry operations and generates focused, chemically interpretable analog spaces rather than large, unconstrained molecular libraries. This strategy enables efficient exploration of structure–activity relationships while maintaining close structural relationships to experimentally tractable lead compounds. Across multiple protein targets and molecular optimization tasks, SpCLM generated compact libraries typically comprising only a few hundred molecules, yet recovered 60%–80% of experimentally validated active compounds from held-out test sets that were not included during model training. Generated molecules showed substantial agreement with experimentally observed structure–activity relationships, including changes in binding affinity and functional activity, demonstrating that the model can reproduce productive chemical transformations without target-specific retraining. These results establish single-point molecular editing as an efficient strategy for translating learned medicinal chemistry knowledge into experimentally relevant molecular optimization. We further applied SpCLM to the development of stimulator of interferon genes (STING) inhibitors as potential therapeutics for Alzheimer’s disease (AD). Because aberrant activation of the cGAS–STING innate immune pathway contributes to neuroinflammatory processes associated with AD and related neurodegenerative disorders, pharmacological inhibition of STING represents an emerging therapeutic strategy. Starting from experimentally characterized STING inhibitor chemotypes, SpCLM generated focused analog series through medicinal-chemistry-like single-point modifications. Integration of model-guided generation with structure-based prioritization and experimental evaluation enabled efficient exploration and optimization of STING inhibitor chemical space, identifying analogs with improved activity and providing experimentally supported structure–activity relationships for further lead development. Together, these results demonstrate that SpCLM bridges generative molecular modeling and practical medicinal chemistry by converting broad chemical knowledge into focused, experimentally actionable structural modifications. By recovering a substantial fraction of experimentally active chemical space from only hundreds of generated candidates and enabling the optimization of therapeutically relevant STING inhibitor chemotypes, SpCLM provides a generalizable framework for reducing the experimental search space and accelerating iterative drug discovery.
items.summary_zh: 提出零样本 Single-Point Chemical Language Model（SpCLM），以受控的单点分子编辑生成小型、可解释的类似物空间；并将模型引导设计、结构优先级排序和实验评价用于 STING 抑制剂优化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 相较大规模无约束生成，该策略更贴近药物化学的局部 SAR 优化且报告了实验支持；60%–80%活性回收率及其跨靶点可推广性仍取决于保留集定义和后续外部验证。
items.abstract_zh: 药物开发在很大程度上依赖于药物化学家识别富有成效的、局部的结构修饰的能力；这些修饰可在保留先导骨架有利特征的同时改善效力、选择性和可开发性。我们在此介绍 Single-Point Chemical Language Model（SpCLM），一种零样本分子优化框架，旨在计算上模拟这一迭代式药物化学范式。SpCLM 构建于 Transformer 架构之上，执行涵盖常见药物化学操作的受控单点分子修饰，生成聚焦且化学上可解释的类似物空间，而非庞大、无约束的分子库。该策略能够高效探索构效关系，同时与实验上可处理的先导化合物保持紧密结构关系。跨多个蛋白靶点和分子优化任务，SpCLM 生成的紧凑文库通常仅包含数百个分子，却从未纳入模型训练的留出测试集中找回了60%–80%经实验验证的活性化合物。生成分子与实验观察到的构效关系高度一致，包括结合亲和力和功能活性的变化，表明该模型无需靶点特异性再训练即可重现富有成效的化学转化。这些结果确立了单点分子编辑作为一种高效策略，可将习得的药物化学知识转化为与实验相关的分子优化。我们进一步将 SpCLM 应用于作为 Alzheimer’s disease（AD）潜在疗法的 stimulator of interferon genes（STING）抑制剂开发。由于 cGAS–STING 先天免疫通路的异常激活会促进与 AD 及相关神经退行性疾病相关的神经炎症过程，对 STING 进行药理学抑制代表一种新兴治疗策略。以实验表征过的 STING 抑制剂化学型为起点，SpCLM 通过药物化学式的单点修饰生成聚焦的类似物系列。将模型引导生成与基于结构的优先级排序和实验评价相结合，能够高效探索和优化 STING 抑制剂化学空间，鉴定出活性改善的类似物，并为进一步先导开发提供了实验支持的构效关系。总体而言，这些结果表明，SpCLM 通过将广泛化学知识转化为聚焦、可实验实施的结构修饰，在生成分子建模与实用药物化学之间架起桥梁。通过仅从数百个生成候选物中找回实验活性化学空间的很大部分，并实现对具有治疗相关性的 STING 抑制剂化学型的优化，SpCLM 提供了一个通用框架，可减少实验搜索空间并加速迭代式药物发现。
items.author_line: Peng Gao, Ying Qin, Zhilian Dai, Yichao Liu, Hao Wen, Jie Zhang, Songyou Zhong, Tenghuan Ge, Chen Wang, Jiawei Fu, Dan Zhang, Ning Zhi, Zhen Zhao

items.title: BigMixSolDB: Extraction of a solubility database in solvent mixtures with an uncertainty-quantified large language model-based pipeline
items.abstract_or_text: The rapidly expanding body of chemical literature contains physical data scattered across unstructured text and complex tables in thousands of publications. Translating this information into machine-readable formats is essential for training data-driven chemical models. The lack of uncertainty quantification in computationally extracted datasets makes manual extraction and curation still necessary. We here address this challenge and present an uncertainty-quantified data extraction pipeline. Our fully automated pipeline utilizes large language models (LLMs) to extract complex tabular and textual chemical data directly from scientific PDFs. We systematically assess several modern LLMs and document-to-text conversion frameworks. We benchmark the uncertainty in extracted data by comparison of our computationally extracted databases with large, existing databases on solubility that are manually curated. Our pipeline achieves between 93 and 79% of the literature contained data, with near-zero median log deviations for structurally matched rows and residual high-magnitude errors concentrated in a small subset of OCR, table-structure, unit-scaling, or reference-dataset discrepancies. We showcase the utility of our pipeline by deploying it to extract data from over 2,000 articles and generate BigMixSolDB, a comprehensive database on solubility in complex mixtures. BigMixSolDB comprises 280,273 solubility entries spanning single, binary, and ternary solvent systems. Our results demonstrate how integrated LLM-based pipelines can be used for literature data extraction that is comparable with manual curation. We envision that these frameworks can be used for large-scale, accurate extraction of literature data into datasets for machine learning applications
items.summary_zh: 构建带不确定性量化的 LLM 化学文献抽取流程，从超过2,000篇文章中建立含280,273条记录的 BigMixSolDB，覆盖单一、二元和三元溶剂体系中的溶解度。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 大规模且显式量化抽取误差的数据资源可支撑溶剂配方与性质模型训练；与人工库相符不等于逐条无误，OCR、表格结构和单位尺度错误仍集中于少数高偏差记录。
evidence_flags: 与人工整理数据库对照
items.abstract_zh: 快速扩展的化学文献主体包含分散在数千篇出版物的非结构化文本和复杂表格中的物理数据。将这些信息转换为机器可读格式，对于训练数据驱动的化学模型至关重要。计算抽取数据集缺乏不确定性量化，意味着人工抽取和整理仍是必要的。我们在此应对这一挑战，并提出一种带不确定性量化的数据抽取流程。我们的全自动流程利用大语言模型（LLMs）直接从科学 PDF 中抽取复杂的表格和文本化学数据。我们系统评估了数种现代 LLM 和 document-to-text 转换框架。我们通过将计算抽取的数据库与大型、现有的人工整理溶解度数据库比较，来评测抽取数据的不确定性。我们的流程达到文献中所含数据的93%至79%，对于结构匹配的行，log 偏差中位数接近零；残余的大幅误差集中在少量 OCR、表格结构、单位缩放或参考数据集差异中。我们通过将该流程部署于从超过2,000篇文章中抽取数据，展示了其效用，并生成 BigMixSolDB——一个关于复杂混合物中溶解度的综合数据库。BigMixSolDB 包含280,273条溶解度记录，涵盖单一、二元和三元溶剂体系。我们的结果表明，整合的基于 LLM 的流程可用于从文献中大规模、准确地抽取数据，其表现可与人工整理相比。我们设想这些框架可用于将文献中的数据大规模、准确地抽取为可供机器学习应用的数据集。
items.author_line: Andrei Voinea, Anna C.M. Thöni, Elija Veenman, Wilhelm T.S. Huck, Tal Kachman, Mathijs F.J. Mabesoone

items.title: Chemical Accuracy for Carbapenem Breakdown by Class A beta-Lactamases Using a Transferable Embedded Machine-Learned Potential
items.abstract_or_text: Bacterial resistance to carbapenems (potent β-lactam antibiotics) is a critical global health threat. The primary cause is β-lactamase enzymes that hydrolyze antibiotics. Previously, carbapenems resisted breakdown, making them ‘last resort’ antibiotics, but enzymes with carbapenemase activity have become widespread. Understanding and predicting the activity of β-lactamases will help in developing antibiotics and inhibitors, and combating antibiotic resistance. Effective prediction requires methods that are both accurate and computationally efficient. Multiscale combined quantum mechanics/molecular mechanics (QM/MM) molecular dynamics simulations of reactions can discriminate between class A β-lactamases (the most widely distributed group) with or without carbapenemase activity, and identify determinants of activity. but face an accuracy/efficiency tradeoff: approximate semiempirical QM methods do not predict reaction barriers accurately, but higher level QM calculations require extensive computer time and resources, making them impractical for rapid predictions. Here, we develop and test a transferable ML/MM framework for the deacylation reaction of the carbapenem meropenem, using the electrostatic machine learning embedding (EMLE) scheme. This model gives free energy barriers to within 1 kcal/mol of values derived from experiment, for four different class A β-lactamases. Crucially, the model was trained only on active site structures from QM/MM simulations of a single enzyme. It did not require retraining to generalize across Class A β-lactamases. It is both faster and more accurate than semi-empirical QM/MM simulations. The ML/MM simulations capture the structural and electrostatic determinants of carbapenemase activity, including oxyanion stabilization and active site electric fields, that differ between enzymes. This work establishes transferable EMLE-based ML/MM simulation as a practical route for accurate, efficient modelling of enzyme-catalyzed reactions.
items.summary_zh: 开发可迁移的 EMLE ML/MM 框架模拟 meropenem 在 A 类 β-lactamases 中的脱酰化；模型仅在一种酶的 QM/MM 构象上训练，报告在四种酶中自由能垒与实验值相差不超过1 kcal/mol。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在不为每种酶重新训练的条件下兼顾 QM/MM 级准确性与效率，有助于研究 carbapenemase 活性及抑制剂设计；验证范围限于四种 A 类 β-lactamases 和一个底物反应。
items.abstract_zh: 细菌对 carbapenems（强效 β-lactam antibiotics）的耐药性是一项严峻的全球健康威胁。其主要原因是能够水解抗生素的 β-lactamase 酶。此前，carbapenems 能抵抗分解，因此被视为“最后防线”抗生素，但具有 carbapenemase 活性的酶已广泛传播。理解和预测 β-lactamases 的活性将有助于开发抗生素和抑制剂，并应对抗生素耐药性。有效预测需要同时准确且计算高效的方法。反应的多尺度量子力学/分子力学（QM/MM）分子动力学模拟能够区分具有或不具有 carbapenemase 活性的 A 类 β-lactamases（分布最广的一类），并识别活性的决定因素，但面临准确性/效率权衡：近似半经验 QM 方法不能准确预测反应势垒，而更高层级的 QM 计算需要大量计算时间和资源，使其不适合快速预测。这里，我们使用 electrostatic machine learning embedding（EMLE）方案，为 carbapenem meropenem 的脱酰化反应开发并测试了一个可迁移的 ML/MM 框架。对于四种不同的 A 类 β-lactamases，该模型给出的自由能垒与实验推导值相差在1 kcal/mol以内。关键的是，该模型仅使用来自一种酶的 QM/MM 模拟活性位点结构训练。它无需重新训练即可泛化到不同的 A 类 β-lactamases。它比半经验 QM/MM 模拟更快且更准确。ML/MM 模拟捕捉了不同酶之间的 carbapenemase 活性的结构和静电决定因素，包括氧阴离子稳定化和活性位点电场。该工作确立了基于 EMLE 的 ML/MM 模拟作为准确、高效建模酶催化反应的实用路径。
items.author_line: Elliot W. Chan, Michael Beer, Kirill Zinovjev, James Spencer, Marc W. van der Kamp, Adrian J. Mulholland

items.title: Physical Metallurgy of Lithium and Sodium and its Role in Electrochemical Stability of Solid-State Battery Anodes
items.abstract_or_text: Alkali metal negative electrodes in solid-state batteries (SSBs) undergo mechanical deformation during cycling, for which an understanding of their physical metallurgy is critical. Here, we study the link between microstructure and plastic deformation in lithium and sodium. Grain size is controlled through deformation processing, and etching methods are developed to reveal grain boundaries, subgrain boundaries, and dislocation structures. Hall-Petch strengthening with decreasing grain size occurs in both metals. Creep rate in lithium is grain-size-independent above the subgrain size, but increases at small grain sizes where diffusional creep dominates. Oxide dispersion-strengthened behavior is observed in Li. At length scales below the subgrain size, strength increases and creep rates decrease due to dislocation starvation. Solid-state electrochemical cell tests in which lithium of differing foil thickness is stripped under pressure validates length-scale effects. Overall, this work provides a physical metallurgy framework for alkali metal deformation and offers design principles for advanced SSBs.
items.summary_zh: 系统研究 Li 和 Na 的晶粒尺寸、位错结构、蠕变与强化，并通过受压剥离的固态电化学电池测试验证长度尺度效应，为固态电池金属负极设计给出冶金学框架。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 把基础塑性变形机制与真实固态电池测试相连，可指导机械稳定的 Li/Na 负极开发；具体设计准则能否跨电解质、界面和长期循环条件迁移仍待验证。
items.abstract_zh: 固态电池（SSBs）中的碱金属负极在循环过程中发生机械变形，因此理解其物理冶金学至关重要。这里，我们研究了微观结构与锂和钠塑性变形之间的联系。通过变形加工控制晶粒尺寸，并开发蚀刻方法以揭示晶界、亚晶界和位错结构。两种金属均表现出随晶粒尺寸减小而发生的 Hall-Petch 强化。在亚晶粒尺寸以上，锂的蠕变速率与晶粒尺寸无关；但在小晶粒尺寸下，扩散蠕变占主导，蠕变速率增加。Li 中观察到氧化物弥散强化行为。在低于亚晶粒尺寸的长度尺度上，由于位错饥饿，强度增加而蠕变速率降低。使用不同箔厚锂在压力下剥离的固态电化学电池测试验证了长度尺度效应。总体而言，本工作为碱金属变形提供了物理冶金学框架，并为先进 SSBs 提供了设计原则。
items.author_line: Chiung-Yuan Lo, Vijay D. Veeraraghavan, Cole D. Fincher, Callum J. Campbell, QianQian Yan, David Mitlin, Yet-Ming Chiang

items.title: Synthesis of 15N-Labelled Complex Saturated N-Heterocycles via Late-Stage Carbonyl-to-Nitrogen Swap
items.abstract_or_text: ‡Process Research and Development, Merck & Co., Rahway, New Jersey 07065, United States ABSTRACT: Efficient construction of 15N-labelled complex saturated N-heterocycles remains a substantial challenge. Here we report a late-stage carbonyl-to-15N skeletal modification strategy that converts complex cyclic ketones directly into 15Nenriched saturated heterocycles. This transformation is enabled by a methylsulfonyl-based 15N-labelled azonation reagent that suppresses unwanted overoxidation without compromising the desired C-C bond cleavage pathway. The reaction exhibits a broad substrate scope and tolerates a wide range of functional groups, serving as an effective tool for late-stage skeletal modifications of complex natural products and drug-like molecules. Mechanistic insights on the sequential double C–C activation events have been elucidated by preliminary computational studies.
items.summary_zh: 报道利用 methylsulfonyl-based 15N-labelled azonation reagent 的晚期 carbonyl-to-15N 骨架编辑，将复杂环酮转化为 15N-enriched 饱和杂环，并展示官能团耐受性与药物样分子适用性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为同位素标记复杂含氮骨架提供了可用于药物代谢和机制研究的晚期改造路线；摘要未给出完整收率、底物数或同位素掺入率，适用边界需查看全文。
items.abstract_zh: 高效构建15N 标记的复杂饱和 N-杂环仍是一项重大挑战。我们在此报道一种晚期 carbonyl-to-15N 骨架修饰策略，可将复杂环酮直接转化为15N 富集的饱和杂环。该转化由一种基于 methylsulfonyl 的15N 标记 azonation reagent 实现；该试剂抑制不需要的过氧化，同时不损害所需的 C-C 键断裂路径。该反应具有广泛的底物范围，并耐受多种官能团，可作为复杂天然产物和药物样分子晚期骨架修饰的有效工具。关于连续双 C–C 活化事件的机制认识已由初步计算研究阐明。
items.author_line: Zining Zhang, Seoung-Tae Kim, Jingwei Li, Guangbin Dong

items.title: Beyond Polar Addition: A Radical Alternative for Enantioselective C–C Bond Formation Driven by Alkylzirconocenes Dual Reactivity
items.abstract_or_text: The catalytic asymmetric addition of organometallic reagents to carbonyl compounds represents a fundamental strategy for the synthesis of enantioenriched alcohols. However, conventional carbanionic nucleophiles (e.g., organomagnesium and organolithium) often suffer from competing deprotonation pathways, uncatalyzed background reactions, limited functional-group tolerance, and sensitivity to moisture and air. Alkylzirconocenes, readily generated from abundant alkenes, offer an attractive alternative by virtue of their functional‑group compatibility, photochemical lability, and capacity for remote chain‑walking. Herein, we report a visible-light-enabled, nickel-catalyzed asymmetric radical addition of alkylzirconocenes to aliphatic aldehydes, providing efficient access to enantioenriched secondary alcohols in good yields with high levels of enantioselectivities. This transformation features broad functional-group tolerance, enabling the late-stage enantioselective modification of complex pharmaceutical molecules and natural products. Notably, alkylzirconocenes serve a dual role in this process, acting as both alkyl radical precursors and sources of Zr(III) species for carbonyl activation. Mechanistic investigations, including control experiments, radical‑clock experiments, kinetic analysis, nonlinear effect studies, support a nickel-catalyzed asymmetric radical addition pathway, wherein a Zr(III) species mediates the single-electron reduction of aliphatic aldehydes to generate ketyl radicals. This work establishes a new paradigm for asymmetric carbonyl addition that circumvents the intrinsic limitations of classical polar mechanisms.
items.summary_zh: 报道可见光驱动、Ni 催化的 alkylzirconocenes 对脂肪醛不对称自由基加成；alkylzirconocenes 同时充当烷基自由基前体和生成 Zr(III) 的来源，得到高对映选择性仲醇。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将易得烯烃转化为兼具自由基供体和羰基活化功能的试剂，扩展了不对称羰基加成策略；实际底物广度、收率和 ee 分布仍需以全文数据判断。
items.abstract_zh: 有机金属试剂对羰基化合物的催化不对称加成，是合成对映体富集醇的一项基础策略。然而，常规碳负离子亲核试剂（如有机镁和有机锂）常遭遇竞争性去质子化路径、未经催化的背景反应、有限的官能团耐受性以及对水分和空气的敏感性。由丰富烯烃方便生成的 alkylzirconocenes，凭借其官能团兼容性、光化学不稳定性和远程 chain-walking 能力，提供了一个有吸引力的替代方案。本文报道了一种可见光促进、镍催化的 alkylzirconocenes 对脂肪醛的不对称自由基加成，可高效获得具有高对映选择性的对映体富集仲醇。该转化具有广泛官能团耐受性，使复杂药物分子和天然产物的晚期对映选择性修饰成为可能。值得注意的是，alkylzirconocenes 在该过程中发挥双重作用，既作为烷基自由基前体，也作为用于羰基活化的 Zr(III) 物种来源。包括对照实验、自由基时钟实验、动力学分析和非线性效应研究在内的机制研究，支持一条镍催化不对称自由基加成路径；其中 Zr(III) 物种介导脂肪醛的单电子还原以生成 ketyl radicals。本工作建立了一种新的不对称羰基加成范式，规避了经典极性机制的内在局限。
items.author_line: Wenqian Miao, Songlin Bai, Qingcui Wu, Xiangbing Qi

items.title: Dynamic vacancy redistribution shifts Pd nanoparticle coalescence from orientation-gated to defect-enabled on reduced CeO2(110)
items.abstract_or_text: Sintering deactivates supported catalysts, yet how mobile support defects couple to crystallographic transport anisotropy during nanoparticle coalescence remains poorly understood. Here, we develop a ternary Ce–O–Pd machine-learning interatomic potential (Ce–O–Pd MLIP) by fine-tuning a pre-trained large atomic model and validate it against density functional theory (DFT) calculations and ab initio molecular dynamics (AIMD). Large-scale deep potential molecular dynamics (DPMD) simulations resolve early-stage coarsening of Pd 62 /Pd 287 nanoparticle pairs on CeO 2–x (110) and reveal direction-selective coalescence: [11̅0]-aligned pairs exhibit higher probabilities and shorter onset times than [001]-aligned pairs. CI-NEB calculations identify complementary transport anisotropies, with Pd adatom diffusion favored along [11̅0] and oxygen-vacancy migration favored along [001], enabling dynamic defect redistribution within the interparticle region. Statistical trajectory analysis shows that increasing the interparticle oxygen-vacancy fraction from 10% to 30% raises coalescence probability and accelerates bridge and neck nucleation, including along the kinetically less favorable [001] alignment. Time-resolved metrics further show that transient low-coordinated bridge-Pd intermediates precede complete particle merging. Together, these results establish defect–transport coupling as a microscopic mechanism for direction-selective sintering on reduced ceria and suggest that suppressing vacancy enrichment and connectivity in interparticle gaps can improve the stability of oxide-supported metal nanoparticles.
items.summary_zh: 以经 DFT 和 AIMD 验证的 Ce–O–Pd MLIP 开展大规模 DPMD，揭示还原 CeO2(110) 上氧空位动态再分布与 Pd 纳米颗粒定向烧结之间的耦合。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将原子势模型、CI-NEB 和统计轨迹结合，给出抑制氧化物负载金属纳米颗粒烧结的微观设计线索；结论主要来自模拟，真实催化剂表面的复杂性仍需原位实验检验。
evidence_flags: 缺少直接原位实验验证
items.abstract_zh: 烧结会使负载型催化剂失活，但可移动的载体缺陷如何在纳米颗粒聚并过程中与晶体学传输各向异性耦合，仍知之甚少。这里，我们通过微调预训练的大原子模型，开发了一个 Ce–O–Pd machine-learning interatomic potential（Ce–O–Pd MLIP），并以 density functional theory（DFT）计算和 ab initio molecular dynamics（AIMD）对其进行验证。大尺度 deep potential molecular dynamics（DPMD）模拟解析了 CeO2–x (110) 上 Pd62/Pd287 纳米颗粒对的早期粗化，揭示了方向选择性聚并：[11̅0] 取向的颗粒对比较[001]取向的颗粒对具有更高概率和更短起始时间。CI-NEB 计算鉴定出互补的传输各向异性：Pd 吸附原子扩散沿[11̅0]更有利，而氧空位迁移沿[001]更有利，从而使缺陷能在颗粒间区域内动态重新分布。统计轨迹分析表明，将颗粒间氧空位分数从10%增加到30%，会提高聚并概率并加速桥接和颈部成核，包括沿动力学上较不利的[001]取向。时间分辨指标进一步表明，瞬态低配位 bridge-Pd 中间体先于颗粒完全合并出现。总之，这些结果确立了缺陷–传输耦合是还原 ceria 上方向选择性烧结的微观机制，并表明抑制颗粒间隙中氧空位的富集和连通性可改善氧化物负载金属纳米颗粒的稳定性。
items.author_line: Shulin Wang, Jilun Song, Liang Cao

items.title: PharmCast: rapid generation of three-dimensional pharmacophore fingerprints from two-dimensional structure without conformer generation
items.abstract_or_text: A three-dimensional pharmacophore fingerprint records the binding features a molecule can present. It is a description of a hand in search of a glove. Because it is defined by presented features instead of two-dimensional structure, it can identify pharmacophoric similarity between structurally distinct compounds, which is what scaffold hopping and non-obvious me-too design require. The descriptor has remained a niche tool because its cost is dominated by conformer generation. In the reference pipeline, generating 100 conformers requires 2.82 s of the 2.86 s needed to fingerprint one screening collection compound; the bit calculation requires 0.039 s. We therefore removed the conformational stage. PharmCast is a feedforward neural network that predicts all 10,549 bits of a PharmPrint ensemble fingerprint directly from a SMILES string. On the same machine, PharmCast generated pharmacophore fingerprints for two molecules and compared them in 0.584 ms, whereas the conventional conformer-based pipeline took 5.71 s. PharmCast version 10 was trained on 5,887,229 molecules drawn from a screening collection, activity-backed ChEMBL compounds from 142 to 1000 Da, and peptide loops excised from crystal structures. We evaluated 155,648 purchasable catalog compounds excluded from every training set, 139,700 activity-backed ChEMBL compounds not present in the version 10 training set, and 13,500 peptide loops reserved for testing. Median fingerprint error, Pearson r, and pairwise ranking accuracy were 0.008, 0.980, and 0.936 for screening collection chemistry; 0.016, 0.984, and 0.952 for loop peptides; and 0.027, 0.936, and 0.889 for activity-backed ChEMBL compounds. The reference calculation reproduces itself at an error of 0.006 and r of 0.995. Ensemble pharmacophore fingerprints can therefore be predicted from two-dimensional structure alone at a cost suitable for large-scale collection screening and virtual library exploration. Keywords: pharmacophore, fingerprint, scaffold hopping, surrogate model, virtual screening, applicability domain
items.summary_zh: PharmCast 以 SMILES 直接预测10,549位 PharmPrint 集合药效团指纹，省去构象生成；在多种排除训练集的化学空间中报告高指纹相关性和排序准确性，并显著降低计算时间。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 若能保持化学检索有效性，二维结构到三维集合药效团的替代模型可降低虚拟筛选成本并支持 scaffold hopping；指纹逼近精度不直接等同于实际命中率或结合活性。
items.abstract_zh: 三维药效团指纹记录一个分子能够呈现的结合特征。它是寻找手套的一只手。由于它由呈现的特征而非二维结构定义，因此它能够识别结构不同化合物之间的药效团相似性，这正是 scaffold hopping 和非显而易见的 me-too 设计所需要的。该描述符一直是小众工具，因为其成本主要由构象生成决定。在参考流程中，为一个筛选化合物库分子生成100个构象，占指纹计算2.86 s所需时间中的2.82 s；位计算仅需0.039 s。因此我们移除了构象阶段。PharmCast 是一个前馈神经网络，可直接从 SMILES 字符串预测 PharmPrint ensemble fingerprint 的全部10,549位。在同一台机器上，PharmCast 为两个分子生成药效团指纹并进行比较仅需0.584 ms，而传统的基于构象流程需5.71 s。PharmCast version 10 在5,887,229个分子上训练，这些分子来自筛选化合物库、分子量142至1000 Da的具有活性支持的 ChEMBL 化合物，以及从晶体结构中切出的肽环。我们评估了155,648个从所有训练集中排除的可购买目录化合物、139,700个未出现在 version 10 训练集中的具有活性支持的 ChEMBL 化合物，以及13,500个留作测试的肽环。对于筛选化合物库化学，指纹误差中位数、Pearson r 和成对排序准确率分别为0.008、0.980和0.936；对于环肽，分别为0.016、0.984和0.952；对于具有活性支持的 ChEMBL 化合物，分别为0.027、0.936和0.889。参考计算自身重现时的误差为0.006、r 为0.995。因此，可仅从二维结构预测集合药效团指纹，成本适用于大规模化合物库筛选和虚拟化合物库探索。关键词：pharmacophore，fingerprint，scaffold hopping，surrogate model，virtual screening，applicability domain。
items.author_line: Muskal, S. M., McGregor, M. J.

items.title: FUSED: A Functional Representation for Joint Structural and Elemental Analysis of Protein Ligand Binding Sites
items.abstract_or_text: Ligand binding site representations are central to the analysis of protein-ligand interactions, with applications in functional characterization, binding-site comparison, and ligand recognition. Many descriptor-based approaches characterize ligand binding sites using a fixed distance threshold from the ligand, despite substantial variability in how such thresholds are defined and the possibility that relevant structural and compositional information changes across spatial scales. We propose Functional Unification of Structural and Elemental Descriptors (FUSED), a multivariate functional representation that jointly models structural and elemental compositional information of ligand binding sites as functions of distance from the ligand. Structural information is captured through covariance-based descriptors derived from the CDPA framework, while chemical composition is represented through isometric log-ratio coordinates to account appropriately for compositional geometry. Treating distance from the ligand as a functional domain allows structural and compositional characteristics to be examined across distance thresholds rather than at a single prespecified value. The resulting representation can be used directly or combined with dimension-reduction, statistical-learning, and/or machine-learning procedures, with the distance interval tailored to the dataset, analytical task, and procedure. We evaluate FUSED on three benchmark datasets spanning complementary ligand binding-site analysis tasks: the Extended Kahraman dataset for multiclass ligand discrimination, TOUGH-C1 for binary binding-site classification, and TOUGH-M1 for pairwise matching of pockets associated with drug-like ligands. FUSED supports strong discrimination in the EK and TOUGH-C1 tasks using standard statistical-learning procedures, while a supervised Siamese neural network applied to the full FUSED representation achieves a mean ROC-AUC of 0.9375 on TOUGH-M1 under repeated sequence-cluster-disjoint evaluation, approaching the strongest reported benchmark performance. These results demonstrate that FUSED provides a flexible, alignment-free representation that supports both direct examination of threshold-dependent binding-site characteristics and competitive downstream classification and pocket matching while remaining computationally practical.
items.summary_zh: FUSED 将蛋白–配体结合位点的协方差结构描述符与元素组成的等距对数比坐标，建模为配体距离的函数；在 EK、TOUGH-C1 和 TOUGH-M1 基准上进行分类和口袋匹配评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 不再固定单一口袋截断阈值的函数式表示，可同时保留结构和化学组成随空间尺度变化的信息；优势目前主要由既有基准衡量，能否改善下游药物发现仍待实证。
items.abstract_zh: 配体结合位点表示是蛋白质–配体相互作用分析的核心，应用于功能表征、结合位点比较和配体识别。许多基于描述符的方法使用距配体的固定距离阈值来表征配体结合位点，尽管此类阈值的定义差异很大，并且相关的结构和组成信息可能随空间尺度改变。我们提出 Functional Unification of Structural and Elemental Descriptors（FUSED），一种多变量函数表示，将配体结合位点的结构和元素组成信息共同建模为距配体的函数。结构信息通过源自 CDPA 框架的协方差描述符获取，而化学组成通过等距对数比坐标表示，以恰当地处理组成几何。将距配体的距离作为函数域，可在不同距离阈值上而非单一预先指定的值考察结构和组成特征。所得表示可直接使用，也可与降维、统计学习和/或机器学习程序结合；距离区间可针对数据集、分析任务和程序定制。我们在三个覆盖互补配体结合位点分析任务的基准数据集上评估 FUSED：用于多类配体区分的 Extended Kahraman 数据集、用于二元结合位点分类的 TOUGH-C1，以及用于与药物样配体相关口袋成对匹配的 TOUGH-M1。FUSED 使用标准统计学习程序在 EK 和 TOUGH-C1 任务中支持强判别；而应用于完整 FUSED 表示的有监督 Siamese neural network，在重复的序列簇不重叠评估下，在 TOUGH-M1 上达到平均 ROC-AUC 0.9375，接近已报告的最强基准性能。这些结果表明，FUSED 提供了一种灵活、免对齐的表示，在保持计算实用性的同时，支持直接考察依赖阈值的结合位点特征，以及具有竞争力的下游分类和口袋匹配。
items.author_line: Priyankara, T. M. S., Ellingson, L.

items.title: Contrastive Reward Based Reinforcement Learning for Goal Directed 3D Molecular Design
items.abstract_or_text: Although three-dimensional flow-matching models have become powerful tools for efficient sampling of high-quality 3D molecular structures, reward-based reinforcement learning for flow-matching models is complicated by the absence of a tractable trajectory likelihood for hybrid molecular states comprising categorical features and continuous coordinates. Existing policy-optimization strategies address this difficulty by stochasticizing the generative process or constructing likelihood surrogates, introducing additional approximations. Here, we present ReCoFlow, a novel trajectorylikelihood-free reinforcement learning framework for reward-contrastive post-training of pretrained molecular flow-matching models. Within ReCoFlow, reward-favored molecules provide positive endpoint supervision for the flow-matching model, whereas reward-disfavored molecules are used to construct reference-guided negative targets. Additionally, an anchor loss to an exponential moving average (EMA) reference model constrains the drift of the fine-tuned model. In benchmarking studies including physicochemical property optimization, three-dimensional shape optimization, and pocket-conditioned 3D molecular generation, ReCoFlow consistently improved the performance of flow-matching models over reward-weighted and surrogate-ratio optimization schemes while maintaining high molecular validity. These results suggest that ReCoFlow could be an effective reinforcement-learning strategy for goal-directed molecular design.
items.summary_zh: ReCoFlow 为预训练3D molecular flow-matching 模型提出无轨迹似然的奖励对比后训练：高奖励终点作正监督、低奖励终点构造参考引导负目标，并以 EMA 锚定损失限制模型漂移。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 针对混合离散/连续分子状态中强化学习难以获得轨迹似然的问题，提出避免额外似然近似的优化方案；结论来自计算基准，奖励函数设定与合成可行性尚未由实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 尽管三维 flow-matching 模型已成为高效采样高质量3D 分子结构的强大工具，但对于由类别特征和连续坐标构成的混合分子状态，基于奖励的 flow-matching 模型强化学习因缺乏可处理的轨迹似然而变得复杂。现有策略通过将生成过程随机化或构建似然替代物来应对这一困难，但会引入额外近似。这里，我们提出 ReCoFlow，一种新颖的无轨迹似然强化学习框架，用于对预训练分子 flow-matching 模型进行基于奖励对比的后训练。在 ReCoFlow 中，奖励偏好的分子为 flow-matching 模型提供正终点监督，而奖励不偏好的分子用于构建参考引导的负目标。此外，对指数移动平均（EMA）参考模型的锚定损失限制了微调模型的漂移。在包括物理化学性质优化、三维形状优化和口袋条件三维分子生成的基准研究中，ReCoFlow 在保持高分子有效性的同时，持续优于奖励加权和替代比率优化方案。这些结果表明，ReCoFlow 可能是一种用于目标导向分子设计的有效强化学习策略。
items.author_line: Bohao Li, Yuedong Yang, Mingyuan Xu, Hongming Chen

items.title: New Paradigm in Ligand Coupling: Formation of C(sp2)–C(sp) Bonds by Hypervalent Bismuth
items.abstract_or_text: Ligand coupling is the principal bond-forming reaction of hypervalent main-group compounds, resulting in the formation of diverse carbon–carbon and carbon–heteroatom bonds. Hypervalent organobismuth reagents are known to undergo ligand coupling to form C–O, C–N, C–S, and carbon–halogen bonds, together with carbon–carbon bonds between enolates and aryl groups or alkenes, and phenoxides and aryl groups. Despite four decades of development in organobismuth chemistry, however, coupling between aryl and alkynyl ligands has remained unreported. Here we show that hypervalent organobismuth undergoes aryl–alkynyl coupling through a previously unknown elementary ligand-coupling reaction. A conformationally constrained, recoverable organobismuth scaffold enables selective aryl transfer to terminal alkynes under mild, transition-metal-free conditions. Mechanistic studies support the intermediacy of a pentacoordinate Bi(V) species that is observable by variable-temperature NMR and capable of ligand exchange prior to reductive coupling. These studies establish aryl–alkynyl coupling as a new elementary reaction of hypervalent organobismuth compounds.
items.summary_zh: 发现超价有机铋可经此前未知的 elementary ligand-coupling reaction 实现芳基–炔基偶联；可回收、构象受限的 organobismuth scaffold 支持温和无过渡金属条件下的末端炔烃芳基化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为超价主族化合物的配体偶联增添 C(sp2)–C(sp) 成键基元，可能拓展低金属负担的合成路线；反应普适性和在复杂合成中的实用性仍需进一步评估。
evidence_flags: 底物普适性待全文核验
items.abstract_zh: 配体偶联是超价主族化合物的主要成键反应，可形成多样的碳–碳键和碳–杂原子键。已知超价有机铋试剂可进行配体偶联，形成 C–O、C–N、C–S 和碳–卤素键，也可形成烯醇盐与芳基或烯烃之间、以及酚盐与芳基之间的碳–碳键。然而，尽管有机铋化学已发展四十年，芳基与炔基配体之间的偶联仍未有报道。我们在此表明，超价有机铋可通过一种此前未知的基元配体偶联反应发生芳基–炔基偶联。一个构象受限、可回收的有机铋骨架，使得在温和、无过渡金属条件下能够选择性地将芳基转移至末端炔烃。机制研究支持可变温 NMR 可观察到的五配位 Bi(V) 物种作为中间体；该物种可在还原偶联前发生配体交换。这些研究确立了芳基–炔基偶联作为超价有机铋化合物的一种新的基元反应。
items.author_line: Yun-Jeong Shin, Li Li, Viresh H. Rawal
